[[File:Rothko.decipher.com 27 March 1997.jpg|thumb|rothko.decipher.com lobby, 27 March 1997.]]
[[File:Decipher.com Dagobah Contest page 1997.jpg|thumb|The Dagobah Contest on rothko, March 1997.]]
'''rothko.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host in 1997. It served the same lobby as www and [[games.decipher.com]], with The Galleries, Star Wars Customizable Cards, Star Trek Customizable Cards, Decipher Shop, Inside Decipher and Decipher's West Wing.<ref name="root">[http://rothko.decipher.com/ Welcome To Decipher!], Decipher (27 March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327204238/http://rothko.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref> The 1997 Dagobah Contest ran on this host under <code>/new/dagobahcontest/</code>.<ref name="dago">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/index.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327204942/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> ''Star Wars CCG'' rules, Squadrons and Dialog pages, including the [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] party write-up, also used this hostname in March 1997.
